title: openyggdrasil Module Skill Declaration
description: Schema for .skill.md YAML frontmatter. Each module declares its reasoning profile for dynamic tollgate routing.

description.description: When this module should be activated. Used for Progressive Disclosure matching.

chain_position.description: Which chain segment this module belongs to.

effort_class.description: Reasoning effort required. high = LLM reasoning lease, medium = LLM single call, low = deterministic only.

requires_reasoning.description: Whether this module needs an LLM reasoning session.

bundle_eligible.description: Whether this module can be bundled with adjacent modules in the same bwrap session.

shared_context.description: Input files or artifacts this module consumes.
